reviews.review:
Well, this game  should have early access tag at this moment (Sep 2025). There is only single stage, there are some translation issues (some buttons are still in chineese), only 7 champions, wit rest marked as "coming soon". Few other notable thigs missing: inventory (list of skills), current stats ( crit chance, HP/mana regen, damage etc). There are still few bugs ( i got a character that was supposed to start with 1 skill, started with 3), some balance is needed, there is no map or important dropped object indicator. 

If you are looking for NSFW , there is barly any... everything is censored, and if I was playing this in the office after hours, its as much NSFW as Bayonetta or few other "safe" games with female characters with skimpy clothing.

Whether you would like to buy this... well t depends on how much you value your gaming in hr/$. I basically tried everything in 3 hours.... tried all characters, got to the last boss (20 min one) on all characters, so basically I could grind a bit to unlock all affection levels, but basically I have done everything there is to do..... I would reccomend Vampire survivor or similar game for complete game-play and 10-20X playtime. 

This game could be fu, but at this point its 3-4 hour game , I would call it early beta. Ig it had early access tag, I would have given it a better review, but its NOT a complete game....
